experiment_data.hypothesis: The metric-dependent layer selection pattern observed on HarmThoughts (crossing_rate selecting shallow layers vs threshold-based metrics selecting deep layers) generalizes to AdvBench, a second dataset with different prompt distribution (adversarial jailbreak prompts vs safety-relevant reasoning). Cross-dataset replication strengthens the claim that layer selection sensitivity is a fundamental property of hidden-state probes, not a dataset-specific artifact.
